How much can you actually fit into one backpack? 👀

I’m heading to Paris in a few weeks and I’m seriously considering attempting the whole trip with just the 40L Marshall Terra from Mokobara.

Four days. Clothes, shoes, toiletries, laptop, tech… all in one backpack.

No suitcase needed.

The empty suitcase I’m taking for the shopping is a completely separate matter. 😂
